findings.label: Runtime layout/mirroring check missing
findings.detail: verification.md states the runtime browser confirmation of non-overlapping side-by-side layout and timepoint label+unit mirroring was NOT driven. The brief designates this check as un-judgeable from code and mandates rejection when it is absent. A human or the finalize step must start the stack, open a worksheet bound to TST-F1F2M, and confirm: tables side by side sharing window width; wide-to-narrow resize auto-fits then stacks with no cell clipping/overlap; typing label+unit in a Test row mirrors into the matching Reference row while mean%/%RSD stay per-product; example profiles yield f1 ~= 5.9 / f2 = 75.9. Capture a screenshot.

findings.label: eslint not run
findings.detail: eslint is not a declared dependency and there is no config in frontend-react, so npm run lint could not run without fetching an unpinned eslint. The production build type-checked the new code clean, so this is informational, but the lint gate in the plan was not satisfiable as written.
